[{"type": "text", "text": "Mathlib/Condensed/AB.lean  (lines 1–70 of 71):
     1  /-
     2  Copyright (c) 2024 Dagur Asgeirsson. All rights reserved.
     3  Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
     4  Authors: Dagur Asgeirsson
     5  -/
     6  module
     7  
     8  public import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.AB
     9  public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Abelian.GrothendieckAxioms.Sheaf
    10  public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Coherent.ExtensiveColimits
    11  public import Mathlib.Condensed.Equivalence
    12  public import Mathlib.Condensed.Limits
    13  /-!
    14  
    15  # AB axioms in condensed modules
    16  
    17  This file proves that the category of condensed modules over a ring satisfies Grothendieck's axioms
    18  AB5, AB4, and AB4`*`.
    19  -/
    20  
    21  public section
    22  
    23  universe u
    24  
    25  open Condensed CategoryTheory Limits
    26  
    27  namespace Condensed
    28  
    29  variable (A J : Type*) [Category* A] [Category* J] [Preadditive A]
    30    [∀ X, HasLimitsOfShape (StructuredArrow X Stonean.toCompHaus.op) A]
    31    [HasWeakSheafify (coherentTopology CompHaus.{u}) A]
    32    [HasWeakSheafify (extensiveTopology Stonean.{u}) A]
    33  -- One of the `HasWeakSheafify` instances could be deduced from the other using the dense subsite
    34  -- API, but when `A` is a concrete category, these will both be synthesized anyway.
    35  
    36  set_option Elab.async false in  -- TODO: universe levels from type are unified in proof
    37  lemma hasExactColimitsOfShape [HasColimitsOfShape J A] [HasExactColimitsOfShape J A]
    38      [HasFiniteLimits A] : HasExactColimitsOfShape J (Condensed.{u} A) := by
    39    let e : Condensed.{u} A ≌ Sheaf (extensiveTopology Stonean.{u}) A :=
    40      (StoneanCompHaus.equivalence A).symm.trans Presheaf.coherentExtensiveEquivalence
    41    exact HasExactColimitsOfShape.domain_of_functor _ e.functor
    42  
    43  set_option Elab.async false in  -- TODO: universe levels from type are unified in proof
    44  lemma hasExactLimitsOfShape [HasLimitsOfShape J A] [HasExactLimitsOfShape J A]
    45      [HasFiniteColimits A] : HasExactLimitsOfShape J (Condensed.{u} A) := by
    46    let e : Condensed.{u} A ≌ Sheaf (extensiveTopology Stonean.{u}) A :=
    47      (StoneanCompHaus.equivalence A).symm.trans Presheaf.coherentExtensiveEquivalence
    48    exact HasExactLimitsOfShape.domain_of_functor _ e.functor
    49  
    50  section Module
    51  
    52  variable (R : Type (u + 1)) [Ring R]
    53  
    54  local instance : HasLimitsOfSize.{u, u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) :=
    55    hasLimitsOfSizeShrink.{u, u + 1, u + 1, u} _
    56  
    57  variable (X Y : CondensedMod.{u} R)
    58  
    59  instance : AB5 (CondensedMod.{u} R) where
    60    ofShape J _ _ := hasExactColimitsOfShape (ModuleCat R) J
    61  
    62  attribute [local instance] Abelian.hasFiniteBiproducts
    63  
    64  instance : AB4 (CondensedMod.{u} R) := AB4.of_AB5 _
    65  
    66  instance : AB4Star (CondensedMod.{u} R) where
    67    ofShape J := hasExactLimitsOfShape (ModuleCat R) (Discrete J)
    68  
    69  end Module
    70  
"}]
